nom: PEACH & LILY Super Reboot Resurfacing Mask

segments.oily: One reviewer with 30-year-old oily-combo skin reports fewer blackheads, refined pores and faded acne scars/sun spots; a post-menopausal reviewer says her formerly oily skin later turned dry and still breaks out.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin (including one 73-year-old) report soft, glowing, retexturized skin but note they need extra moisturizer afterward as the mask can feel parching.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one describing sensitive combination with a compromised barrier, report clearer, unclogged, radiant skin with minimal irritation when timing is adjusted.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report tingling that fades quickly with no redness, irritation or breakouts afterward, while a smaller group describes real burning, days-long irritation, or advise shortening application time.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s to 70s) consistently report smoother texture, less visible wrinkles/fine lines, brighter tone and refined pores after use.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, smoother texture and brighter, more youthful-looking skin, sometimes after a single use; no reviewer reports aging concerns worsening.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers note skin feels soft and hydrated after rinsing, but others (including dry-skin users) say the mask leaves skin parched and requires heavier moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no redness or lasting irritation even with regular use; a minority describe immediate burning and skin that stayed irritated or discolored for days.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with a stated compromised or reactive barrier generally report tolerating the mask well with shortened wear time; one reviewer explicitly warns the product requires an already strong, consistent-routine barrier to avoid burns.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation and acne scars with regular weekly use, sometimes visible within one month; no dissent reported on this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers frequently report clearer skin, fewer active breakouts, shrunken bumps and cleared blackheads; a couple of reviewers instead report new breakouts or worsened acne irritation after use.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers mention refined, smaller-looking pores after use; no reviewer specifically reports reduced oil production, and none report increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Severe burning reported by some users
Long-lasting jar, little needed per use

extraits.texte: I did not like this product. Mild burning was not the case for me. It started burning immediately and I tried to wait 10 minutes but was so ready to wash off immediately. I lasted 5 min. My face was irritated for days afterwards. My daughter and husband used it and they tolerated it well. Just didn't work for me. I would like to try other products but not this anymore.

The first time I used it i was shocked. Only for 10 minutes and I felt like it took years off of my face. Love this product. My skin is so soft and shiny. It looks new.

I'm 73yrs old w/dry skin. I've been taking care of my skin in only the past 10 yrs but I've tried a lot. I use Retinol A but everything else is P&L. I finally tried Super Reboot mask & I'm blown away. This was my 1st time. Kept on for 29 minutes f/b copper serum & peptide moisturizer & results were amazing!! I still have wrinkles but my skin is glowing, retexturized & even my pores much less noticeable. Honestly don't hesitate. I've never, ever tried anything this rewarding. P. S. stay away from eye area.

My skin is combination sensitive with a pretty bad barrier. I was hesitant with this mask but have loved all the other Peach and Lily products I've used. I bought the travel size and once a week apply for 15 minutes. Online recommends 15 to 20 minutes while the jar recommends 5-20 minutes. Once you've applied it dries to a very shiny thin layer on your skin and is almost not noticeable unlike many masks on the market.
This is something that will always be in my skin care routine. I use this once a week. I have roseca and very sensitive skin, and this is wonderful.

I've been using this mask for my sensitive combination (oily, normal), dehydrated (not dry), hormonal acne-prone skin. My last jar ran out a few months ago, and I hadn't repurchased. I definitely noticed a difference. I've had it again for about 10 days now, and it's just the best. Moisturized, unclogged, radiant skin! I do feel a little stinging/tingling in the beginning, but even when I used it for 20 minutes, I had no irritation.
